description:
This week’s launch of “Grand Theft Auto VI” is arguably the biggest media and entertainment event of the year. Some might even go further, since gamers have been waiting so long for Thursday’s release — the last “Grand Theft Auto” game came out in 2013 — and FOMO is kicking in among the general public. About 15 million copies of “GTA VI” have already been preordered, according to Sensor Tower data. Take-Two Interactive CEO Strauss H. Zelnick told investors last week that the sales are at “unprecedented levels.”

Calling “GTA” “the biggest entertainment franchise in history,” podcaster Nick Martell points out that the gross proceeds of the new game will exceed the box office take of “Avengers: Endgame” and have a bigger economic impact than Taylor Swift’s Eras Tour. “The video game industry is now bigger than the movie and the music industry combined,” Martell adds.
